classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate and rank de novo 85 aa soluble protein candidates with RFdiffusion backbone generation, ProteinMPNN sequence design, Protenix refolding, structure analysis, protein QC, and final ranking, then return the top sequence with rationale.
assumptions: The validated local template `rfdiffusion_backbone_design_round` is the best match for a de novo 85 aa monomer design request.

Solubility will be operationalized by downstream ranking using refold confidence and QC proxies such as favorable GRAVY, low polybasic character, reasonable instability index, and absence of obvious structural liabilities from structure analysis.
A single top-ranked candidate is sufficient because the user asked for one output protein sequence and rationale.
Template-internal helper tool `mpnn_to_protenix_input` is available locally as required by the selected workflow template.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

workflow_plan.name: rfdiffusion_backbone_design_round
workflow_plan.description: Generate one RFdiffusion backbone, design sequences, refold, analyze structure, QC, and rank candidates.

deliverables: Top-ranked de novo 85 aa protein sequence.
Short rationale based on Protenix refold result, structure-analysis summary, QC metrics, and final ranking.
acceptance: Workflow completes using `rfdiffusion_backbone_design_round` with length fixed at 85 aa.
At least one RFdiffusion backbone is generated and inverse-folded into candidate sequences.
At least one top-ranked candidate is refolded by Protenix and evaluated by structure analysis and protein QC.
Final result contains one ranked output sequence and a concise justification for why it was selected.
